8.3.14.en:
Deleting an adapter in a multihost system deletes it also on the other running hosts that hold its package but no longer need it: each host is asked with `getAdapterUsage` (js-controller 8.0 and newer), which also knows the packages a host keeps for the web extension of an instance on another host. A host that does not run or does not answer keeps the package. `iobroker del` on the command line still deletes on its own host only
The dialog "Write value" shows how big a string or JSON value is
Fixed: in the dialog "Write value" the value type was empty for JSON values and the type "JSON/Object" did not open the JSON editor
Instances can get the log level "off" (no log at all, not even errors), if js-controller 8 runs on their host

El administrador de dispositivos de los ajustes o una pestaña de una instancia se puede fijar a la navegación, como en la pestaña (#3738)

Okno dialogowe „Wpisz wartość” pokazuje, jak duży jest ciąg znaków lub wartość JSON

Przegląd: panele mają ten sam kolor co płytki szybkiego dostępu

Zaktualizowano @iobroker /socket-client do wersji 5.7.0 (`callbacktimeout`) i @iobroker /json-config do wersji 10.1.24 (`sendTo` timeout)
Menedżer urządzeń w ustawieniach lub zakładce wystąpienia można przypiąć do nawigacji, jak na karcie Menedżer urządzeń (#3738)

8.3.11.en:
Fixed: in the file rights dialog, a "different" permission could not be set for all files
Updated @iobroker/json-config to 10.1.19: added the control `diskSelector` to select a file or a folder on the disk of the host where the instance runs (needs js-controller with `CONTROLLER_READ_DISK_DIR`)
Fixed: saving the instance settings writes only the settings changed in the dialog, so a setting the adapter wrote into its native while the dialog was open (e.g. its device list) is no longer set back (json-config 10.1.19)
Updated @iobroker/socket-classes to 2.10.3: the host commands `readDiskDir` and `deleteDiskFile` need the permission for `cmdExec`

Обновлено @iobroker /socket-classes до версии 2.10.3: командам хоста «ReadDiskDir» и «DeletetedDiskFile» требуется разрешение для «CmdExec»
8.3.11.pt:

8.3.11.es:
